publish.title: Name your booleans like questions
publish.description: Prefixes that make boolean names read like sentences, and why to avoid double negatives.

scenes.headline: Name your booleans
scenes.narration: A boolean is a yes or no question. Name it like one.

scenes.headline: Vague or clear
scenes.narration: A name like flag or status tells you nothing. A name like isLoading says exactly what is true.

scenes.headline: Handy prefixes
scenes.narration: Use is for a state, has for ownership, can for ability, and should for intent.

scenes.headline: Avoid double negatives
scenes.narration: A negative name turns into a double negative in an if. Name the positive case instead.

scenes.headline: Future you says thanks
scenes.narration: Rename one boolean today. Future you will say thanks.
